title: Choose a useful caller contract
explanation: The demo supplies two concrete objects with a limit of 8. Both references have the declared type TopicLabel. The caller show asks only for render; it does not read the stored limit or choose a shortening algorithm.

title: Vary the hidden shortening step
explanation: For the same padded input, the inherited render method strips whitespace, checks length and invokes the concrete object's shorten method. Both results fit the limit, with different tradeoffs for indicating omitted text.

title: Reuse the concrete common behavior
explanation: A short topic fits after stripping. render returns it without calling shorten. An abstract class can supply a fully implemented method and private instance state even though it cannot be directly instantiated.

title: Check the shared boundary
explanation: Blank input is rejected by render. A limit of 3 is rejected by the abstract base constructor during concrete subclass construction, so that new expression returns no label object.
